newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emirate of Dubai sets up board to promote tourism.
newsitem.headline: Emirate of Dubai sets up board to promote tourism.

text.p: The ruler of the emirate of Dubai in the oil-rich United Arab Emirates on Thursday ordered the creation of a government department to organise and promote tourism, the official news agency WAM said.

Sheikh Maktoum bin Rashid al-Maktoum, UAE Vice-President and Prime Minister, asked his younger brother Sheikh Mohammad bin Rashid al-Maktoum, crown prince of Dubai and the UAE's Defence Minister, to head the body, it added.

Dubai last year eased visa regulations in a move aimed at accelerating its drive to become the Gulf's tourism and shopping centre. Over 1.3 million people stayed in Dubai hotels last year, including luxury resorts built along its long Gulf coastline.
